from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class RegionalStart(BaseModel):
    """A record of new housing starts for a specific month, region, and document release."""
    month: str = Field(description="The month of the housing start data, format YYYY-MM")
    region: str = Field(description="The geographic region (e.g., Northeast, Midwest, South, West)")
    value: float = Field(description="The number of private housing units started, not seasonally adjusted")
    release_date: str = Field(description="The date the report was released, format YYYY-MM-DD, to resolve conflicts")
    status: str = Field(description="Data status marking: 'preliminary' or 'revised'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates all extracted regional start data points from the documents."""
    regional_starts: list[RegionalStart]
